save.text: Sam absent; Scanlan will be run by Keyleth and Percy; Pike still in New York; Patrick Rothfuss (Kerrek) joins via Skype.
Lootcrate sponsorship returned; January theme 'origins'; order cutoff 9PM tonight; URL lootcrate.com/criticalrole; promo code 'criticalrole' for 10% off first month.
Blue Microphones sent new equipment; Matt uses Blue mics; site bluemic.com.
New store item: socks with 'How do you want to do this?' and logo; potential future 'Sox Machina'; dice restock hoped this or next month; pins and bracelets limited stock available.
Anime Milwaukee attendance Feb 17–19: Matt, Marisha, Travis, Laura; Critical Role panel, signings; Wisconsin; Patrick may meet for dinner.
Sam absent; Scanlan, Percy leveled; Pike leveled; Pike in NYC; Keyleth+Percy run Scanlan; Patrick Rothfuss (Kerrek) joins via Skype.
New loot: Dwarven Thrower warhammer found in hoard; +3, thrown 20/60, returns; extra 1d8 (2d8 vs Giants); requires attunement by a dwarf.
Party long-rested in Whitestone; full HP, half HD; spells refreshed; attunement changes discussed: Keyleth gets boots back from Vex; Grog considering Dragonkilling sword; warhammer identified.
Matt: Non-dwarf can attune Dwarven Thrower only while attuned to Belt of Dwarvenkind; removing belt forces hammer unattune.

Attunements/gear updates: Vax attunes Deathwalker's Ward to necrotic; Pike offered Boots of Elvenkind (no attunement per Matt) but would replace Sprinter’s Boots; swapping boots mid-mission is slow; Keyleth consents to Vex wearing boots now.

Grog may attune Dwarven Thrower (d8 damage, thrown 20/60, returns); considered dropping Blood Axe; Dancing Sword is in Grog’s possession and needs attunement; Kerrek has 2 attuned, has an open slot and can use Dancing Sword.

Dancing Sword revealed a curse when Grog handed it over: it inerted and inflicted Grog with permanent -2 to all saving throws; Matt corrected prior card ruling; removal requires divine-level intervention; Pike considering Greater Restoration.
Matt: The -2 to all saves on Grog is from an expended curse; persists until a god removes it; not a normal curse. Correction from last session acknowledged.
Keyleth offered Ring of Protection +2 to Grog (would give +2 AC and saves); requires attunement; Grog declined due to attunement/jewelry preference.
Pike cast Greater Restoration (5th-level) on Grog’s curse headache; no effect; Matt: no divine magic can fix his gas (joke).
Heroes' Feast cast by Pike using diamond from hoard; feeds party incl. Trinket, Kerr, Allura, Kima; effects: immune to fear and poison; +15 max HP for everyone; advantage on Wisdom saves.

Vox Machina loaned items to Kerrek: Cloak of Displacement (over armor) and Vax’s Ring of Invisibility; ring keeps wearer invisible until removed, attacking, casting a spell, or bonus action to end; Vax expects it back post-dragon.
Scrying at a location creates a visible sensor; creatures with see invisibility can see the scrying orb; concern about tipping off Opash. Group opts to go without scrying first.

Party loadout/loans: Vox Machina loaned Kerrek Cloak of Displacement (over armor) and Vax’s Ring of Invisibility; Vax expects ring back post-dragon. Kima and Allura join, fully prepped; they ate Heroes’ Feast.
Travel plan: Use Transport via Plants (6th) instead of Allura’s Teleport (7th) to reach Opash’s island. Leave a Gate Stone with Cassandra via Kima for emergency return signal.
Kima accepted Vex’s Elven Boots to be quieter; she equips them despite not liking the style.
Travel executed: Keyleth casts Transport via Plants to a tree on Opash’s Island of Viscan; Allura and Kima accompany. Pass Without Trace cast before entry.
Second scry with Allura targeted the Island of Viscan (not Opash directly); trees near the lab’s mountain seen. Group avoided scrying on location before traveling to reduce detection risk.
Kima’s Elven Boots gave her normal stealth (disadvantage negated) during the Viscan approach.
Keyleth confirms the island’s trees are long-dead/petrified for hundreds of years; not a recent effect.
Vex finds no dragon tracks; only small indigenous wildlife tracks present.
Matt: Viscan ground has multiple unstable “hollow earth” patches—magically eroded subsurface causing sinkhole-like collapse; avoid dark/damp-looking ovals (10–15 ft).
Kima’s Elven Boots gave her normal stealth (disadvantage negated) during the Viscan approach; party later identifies and avoids multiple hollow-earth sinkholes en route to mountain base.
Keyleth Nature 22: confirms patches are hollow earth from magical release beneath ground; very unstable and dangerous.

Perception at mountain base: Vax nat 20 (32 total) and Vex 30 spot a 20–30 ft boulder jammed into an entrance about 200 ft ahead; surface shows clustered pierced holes made by very large dragon claws; boulder has been placed/removed many times over years.
Party plan debate: consider Stone Shape at seam to thin/create crack rather than moving whole boulder; keep boulder to block dragon escape; discussion of recon rejected (2 hrs to fly full perimeter).
Matt: Trees not blown—no directional blast; they rapidly died in place; terrain gets deader closer to mountain.
Vex casts Primeval Awareness: senses three dragon life forces within 1 mile, toward/below mountain; Matt clarifies range 1 mile (not favored terrain).
Plan shift: party decides to go in now, stealthing; minimal further prep; Rothfuss PC uses Divine Sense at boulder (no celestial/fiend/undead detected).
Item trade: Grog trades Periapt of Wound Closure to Vex for the Deck of Many Things; Vex extracts promise Grog won’t draw/look, keeps it in pouch.
Trade confirmed: Vex returns Deck of Many Things to Grog; Grog trades Periapt of Wound Closure; he promises not to look while Vex is present; Grog thanks Vex.
Keyleth casts Stone Shape (4th): creates small crack; wall+boulder thicker than 5 ft; narrow opening allows arm through, not passage.
Vex fires Oracle Arrow through crack (nat 20 attack): tunnel is dark, undisturbed dust, no tracks; about 100 ft in it curves left and descends; arrow sticks, vision remains.
Party debates entry: second Stone Shape would work to carve pullable chunk; concern about noise if Grog uses siege gauntlets.
Grog investigates boulder: finds large dragon-sized fingerholds; boulder jammed in place, no switch.
Plan floated: use lever through crack with long magical weapon (ask Kima to insert Holy Avenger) to pry boulder; Kima warns: "You ding it, you pay."

Lever plan executed: Pike assists Grog using Kima’s Holy Avenger as lever; Grog STR 23 shifts boulder; party aids; Immovable Rods wedged into dragon finger-holes to hold gap ~1.5 ft; Kima retrieves sword after entry.
Tunnel beyond crack: 15 ft wide, ~12 ft tall; dust, smell of rot/stagnant water; carved passage curves left and descends; no airflow; scattered charred bone shards on floor.
Two Immovable Rods left wedging boulder; door effectively wedged shut from outside; party notes to retrieve on exit.
Group stealth: Vex 30, Vax 35, Percy 34, Keyleth 30, Grog 30 (corrected from 28), Pike 25, Scanlan 18, Kerrek 29.
Pike casts Death Ward (4th-level) on Vex; lasts 8 hours; triggers to keep her at 1 HP when reduced to 0.
Percival and Kerrek lack darkvision; Vax lights Flametongue Dagger to provide light for Kerrek.
Matt: Flametongue dagger light is candle-level; without it Vax sees ~15 ft dimly; with it he sees decently to 60 ft for checks.
Percy and Kerrek, lacking darkvision, move in darkness by linking arms: Keyleth guides Percy; Grog guides Kerrek; light put away for stealth.

Vax actively searching for traps; with dagger out he makes regular Investigation checks; found shelves with candles, skull, small books, wooden box (not trapped), and a mummified raccoon-like creature; chose not to take items.
Kerrek used Divine Sense; Matt first said vague undead nearby, then corrected: Kerrek senses type/location through walls unless total cover; sensed an undead presence to their left on a wall area.
Grog (with Belt of Dwarvenkind darkvision) examined left shelf: two mostly melted candles and a slightly singed human skull; he retrieved the skull and handed it to Kerrek.
Vax cannot read the book titles found earlier; knows Common, Elvish, Abyssal; Matt confirmed titles not readable to him.
Kerrek used Divine Sense on skull; Matt confirms skull is the undead source; later Divine Sense finds no undead within 60 ft in the chamber.
Skull placed in burlap sack and set back on shelf facing wall; not moving or reacting when held.
Marching order: Twins front; Grog & Kerrek; Keyleth & Percy; Ash & Scanlan; Kima & Allura with Trinket in rear.
Keyleth lights hands; provides torchlight. Kerrek and Percy now see room better incl. central iron bowl on pillar, large smooth-seam iron door opposite, brazier and single tome on shelf.
Investigation of iron bowl finds dried liquid residue; scraping yields dark burgundy powder tasting of iron—party infers old blood; likely blood bowl mechanism.
Room details: ancient stone masonry, some cave-ins; no ceiling gaps for drop doors; no visible levers/panels/chains; door seams smooth—likely magical mechanism.
Book on shelf not trapped; when dropped open, text becomes unreadable—focus makes letters shrink/blur; title also obscures similarly.
Bright radiant light from Kerrek’s hammer makes book pages go nearly blank (text shrinks to tiny dots).
Percy suggests extinguishing all lights; someone with low-light/darkvision should read the book; lights being turned off considered.
Brazier lit explodes violently; Keyleth at ground zero; others nearby save for half; Kerrek fails. Brazier destroyed; room rocked; door remains closed.
Book by shelf was a trap/decoy; explosion/aftermath burned it entirely; Allura infers book’s purpose was to mislead/explode.
Radiant light from Kerrek’s hammer made book text vanish; even with hammer off, text remained blurred to party; post-explosion book destroyed.
Basilisk-blood bowl: adding small amount of PC blood triggers mechanism; basilisk blood repelled to edges, door lifts; minor 1 HP loss to donor.

After door opens, four flame skulls (two each corridor) approach; Pike casts Holy Aura creating radiant circle; enemies have disadvantage, party adv on saves; fiends/undead melee must CON save or be blinded.
Flame skulls likely related to one previously found in a bag; combat initiated; initiatives: Scanlan 22 (nat20), Keyleth 22 (nat20), Vax 21, Percy 17, Vex 16, Grog 14.
Initiative additions: Pike 9; Kerrek 1 (last, jokes as anchor-man).
Scanlan casts Invisibility (2nd level) and backs to northern wall; Vax flies 10 ft up to opposite wall and hits a flame skull twice (Whisper + Venom Dagger) for 29 total damage.

Four flame skulls advance from beyond the lifted gate; party circles around Pike; Keyleth casts Moonbeam catching two skulls, both fail CON saves and take 13 radiant; the one Vax hit is badly flickering.
Flame skulls each cast Fireball simultaneously; party (clustered by Pike) targeted; DC 13 DEX saves with advantage from aura.

Saves and damage: Vax evades all (0 dmg); Keyleth saves all, down to 50 HP; Percy saves all, takes 56; Vex saves all, takes 56 (to 57 HP); Kerrek saves all, takes 56; Grog fails 2/succeeds 2, takes 88; Pike fails two but has fire resistance: 44; Scanlan unaffected (Invisibility, not targeted).
Trinket failed 3 of 4 saves; recalled into necklace immediately after damage.
Flame skulls suffer from holy radius; at end of their turn they retreated toward walls/around rubble to avoid it.
Percy (Animus) killed two flame skulls this turn: first the badly flickering one; then another after two more shots; regained grit on each kill; moved to perch on wall.

Kerrek’s Aura of Divinity grants +3 to saves; retroactively changes results: Pike reduces fire damage by 11; Grog’s two failed Dex saves become successes, so he took 56 total (not 88); Trinket still failed three saves.
